Wilds — Click-through UI Demo · v5

Click it like the real app. Avatar, utilities, quest line, dock, gear — all live.

No generated art. Tabs above are a quick-jump for review, but the actual navigation lives inside each screen — click the avatar, the utility rooms, the quest line, the dock, an equipped item. One unified top bar (health bar, avatar, silver, mushroom, gear, cancel) now sits on every in-game screen. Dock is locked to icon + label. NPC lines pop up on entry and fade on their own, like the real ChatBubble.gd — no more sitting permanently in the panel.
